description: Build an original AI character or influencer from traits instead of photos, like Character Studio's builder: type (realistic, bold or extreme caricature, anime, 3D, cat, dog, fox, frog, insect, robot...), gender, age (adults only), body, height, wild proportions (egg body, long limbs, tiny waist), head shape (gigachad, mega jaw), hair, face features, style and accessories. action "traits" (free) lists every trait and option id; action "build" renders up to 4 takes from picks (and/or randomize). Keep one with pixeldojo_save_character.

action.description: traits = list trait and option ids (free). build = render the takes (paid).

details.description: build: up to 200 characters of extra look, e.g. "freckles, gold hoops, a vintage denim jacket".

picks.description: build: {"trait id": "option id"}, e.g. {"type": "frog", "hair": "mullet", "hairColor": "blonde", "distinctive": ["gold-grill"], "style": "retro"}. Ids from action "traits"; labels work too.

randomize.description: build: fill every trait not in picks at random.

name: pixeldojo_build_character
title: Build AI character from traits
